title: Nien Nunb
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Nien Nunb was a member of the Rebel Alliance. He was at the briefing when Mon Mothma announced the attack on the second Death Star. Nien Nunb co-piloted the Millennium Falcon with Lando Calrissian. Lando, Nunb and their crew flew into the superstructure of the Death Star and fired the shots that destroyed the station.
